correctness.rationale: For p=1/10 the substitution r=theta^(1/5) gives a cubic with a unique smooth physical root y>1 for every r>1. The published eigenvalue formulas give |lambda_2|<256/3125, so only lambda_1 can meet Kesten--Stigum. Exact resultant elimination yields the stated factorization; an exact Sturm count gives one P-root above 1 and isolates it in (1.47075929,1.47075930). Exact sign certificates at r=1 and r=2 fix the physical-branch crossing. The embedded verifier reconstructs these certificates.

value.rationale: The Kesten--Stigum boundary is a theorem-level phase diagnostic used by the source to assert non-extremality. Moving the certified onset from about 1523.4 to about 6.8819 changes the anti-ferromagnetic non-extremality region by more than two orders of magnitude and exposes a direct consistency issue between the numerical conclusion and the displayed transition spectrum. This is structurally meaningful rather than an arbitrary numerical refinement.
